about_the_game:
Through this demo, you can play approximately 85% of Chapter 1 of Yoram.
The full game is composed of a total of 3 chapters.

Explore the world of Yoram freely through the demo and make your final decision. :)

This demo contains depictions of drug use, alcohol consumption, direct and indirect domestic violence, and strong language.

Please be advised before playing.

  • You are Irene Lindbergh, a young writer disowned by her own family.

  • Your father, once the most prominent businessman in London, died in a tragic accident.

    Now, under a torrential rain, the heirs of the family gather at the estate, each with their eyes on the vast inheritance.

  • Cutting words and old grudges wound you deeply as you navigate the toxic web of family ties.

  • Was it the pain that ran too deep? Or merely a mistake?
    In a moment you can’t take back, you commit a murder
    —though, perhaps… it wasn’t so accidental after all.

  • The detective leans in, his voice low and heavy with suspicion.
    He speaks as if unveiling a secret he almost doesn’t want to know.

    "Someone must have done it," he says.
    "But only one person could not have."

    And as the silence settles like fog over the room,
    you realize—

    you’re the only one with an alibi.

  • Then, on the second day, another murder is discovered in the mansion.

    While everyone fears a serial killer is among them, only you know the truth.

  • Perhaps you are the one closest to uncovering what really happened.

    But is it worth the risk?

    Is the truth ever worth that much?

Game Introduction

YORAM is a mystery visual novel set in Victorian London.

Step into the mind of Irene Lindbergh—a disgraced writer who has committed a hidden crime.

When a second, unexplained murder rocks the estate, she must navigate suspicion, lies, and buried family secrets to uncover the truth— all while keeping her own guilt buried.

Take your time with the story YORAM has to tell.

There’s no need to rush.
Savor a tale that unfolds slowly—but inevitably—against a backdrop of elegantly drawn characters and richly detailed scenery.

When you're given the freedom to move, wander the mansion.
Talk to the people within its walls.

Uncover what drives them.
What binds them.
What they long for—
and what might break them.

Everything you see, hear, and investigate is recorded automatically in your notes.

Hold onto that information.
You’ll need it—when the moment of crisis finally arrives.

And when that moment does come…

Save yourself.

By any means necessary.
Even if it means hurting someone.
Even if it means lying.

Even if it means crushing the truth beneath your feet-.

short_description: A mansion drenched in heavy rain. Heirs gathered, each eyeing the family fortune. And you—who committed a murder in their midst. As a chain of killings begins, YORAM follows Irene Lindbergh, a murderer hiding her crime, as she searches for the truth buried deep within the estate.
